The recurrence is nonetheless substantive and pair-specific (same sub-strand habit sustained across consecutive terms of the same grade), so symmetric relatesTo is appropriate rather than no_relation. judgment.rationale: Both Skills sit in Grade R (rank 0), Term 3, Skill Area 'Listening and Speaking (Oral)', but under different Sub-strands: 'Processes information' ('Picks out selected information from a description') and 'Uses language to investigate and explore' ('Gives explanations and offers solutions'). Their Learning Components show complementary but distinct capabilities: selecting/comprehending information from an oral description versus producing oral explanations and offering solutions. They are mutually reinforcing facets of Grade R oral language (listening comprehension feeding and accompanying oral reasoning), giving substantive conceptual coherence, but the same grade and same term with no evidence of increased complexity, broadened scope, or dependency does not support a developmental direction; the shared ancestors, page proximity and the single shared LC tag 'oral' (jaccard 0.09) are weak, non-semantic signals. Both endpoints' source evidence is truncated (24 omitted items each), so no stronger claim is warranted.
